title: Implement psp-etl analyze CLI command (issue L1). Add to src/psp_etl/cli.py: 'analyze' subcommand with --reanalyze flag. Fetches unanalyzed blobs via db.get_unanalyzed_entries(), calls strings.analyze_blob() for each unique blob_sha256, stores results via db.insert_string_analysis() and db.insert_strings(). With --reanalyze, re-analyzes all. Shows rich progress bar. See DESIGN.md CLI Interface.
